text.simpletimer.config.title: Simple Spawn Timer Config
text.simpletimer.config.showKeybinds.too: Show Ctrl/Cmd reset hints under each timer
text.simpletimer.config.showClickHints.t: Show click/double-click hints instead of Ctrl/Cmd keybind hints
text.simpletimer.config.hotkeyResets.too: Allow resetting timers with Ctrl/Cmd + number keys
text.simpletimer.config.draggable.toolti: Allow dragging timers while chat is open
text.simpletimer.config.showBackground.t: Draw the progress/background bar behind timer text
text.simpletimer.config.size.tooltip: Scale of the on-screen timer HUD
text.simpletimer.config.warningThreshold: Timer turns yellow and plays a sound this many seconds before expiry
text.simpletimer.config.showWarningMessa: Show a chat message when the warning threshold is reached
text.simpletimer.config.alarmDuration.to: How long the bell alarm plays when a timer expires (0 disables it)
text.simpletimer.config.spawnAlarmDurati: How long the pling alarm plays when a mob spawns (0 disables it)
text.simpletimer.config.volume.tooltip: Volume for warning and alarm sounds (0–100%)
text.simpletimer.config.showWaypoints.to: Draw floating countdown labels at timer waypoints
text.simpletimer.config.waypointDistance: How far away waypoint labels stay visible (blocks)
text.simpletimer.config.waypointShowBack: Draw a background behind waypoint labels
text.simpletimer.config.waypointHeight.t: How high above your feet the label floats (blocks)
text.simpletimer.config.waypointShowDist: Show distance in meters on waypoint labels
Show coordinates [X, Z] in spawn timer names
text.simpletimer.config.spawnGridSize.to: Mobs within this many blocks share the same timer (prevents clones from small coordinate differences)
text.simpletimer.config.missingCloth.mes: Install Cloth Config to edit Simple Spawn Timer settings here. You can still use /STimer config in chat.
